content: With random numbers fixed by seed, draws train_size training images and test_size test images, keeping the share of each digit (stratified). The default counts are kept small so that the helpers' runs, waiting their turn, do not take long. Scales pixels to 0–1, makes them 784-dimensional vectors, and passes them to every classifier in an npz file. Shows the count per digit.

outputs.name: subset
outputs.description: The normalised subset (an npz of train_images, train_labels, test_images, test_labels, digest)
